# Identity debt of the LO16 targets -- GENERATED by `make got-debt`
#   (python3 tools/gotident.py --write-debt, after a full `make check`).
# One row = one green copy (SYMBOL@UNIT) with identical instructions in which a local
# GOT + LO16 pair (a local-page call `lw t9`+`addiu t9`, a `la`, a `lw/sw %lo(x)`)
# reaches an address different from the original: the wrong function of the same TU,
# or a data object outside the placement of its section. Same ratchet as the GOT debt.
# See tools/gotident.py.
